beats.text: {er_lead}, {audit_lead} and {quant_lead} are on the position.

Audit: Micron qualifies. The approved model v1 rates it Outperform, the portfolio holds no Micron today and has the cash. One departure: ten percent is above the usual 3, 5 and 8 percent tiers, so it is your decision, Stott, not a standard size.

At ten percent, the bear case (target $306.91) costs the portfolio 7.1% of its value, the base case adds 1.7% and the bull case adds 4.5% (our arithmetic: ten percent times each case's return). The downside is real but bounded, and it is the reason I would not go above ten.
